svg.title: Reduced candidate capability map
svg.text: P3_SWELLING: capable=True; requires >= 2.677 resistance ratio at 11/5 bar
P4_MOBILE_DEPOSITED_FINES: capable=True; requires >= 2.677 resistance ratio at 11/5 bar
P6_MACHINE_BOUNDARY_DYNAMICS: capable=False; none under measured basket-pressure prescription
P7_STATIC_LATERAL_PATHS: capable=False; none with pressure-independent parallel paths
G1_GRIND_TO_STRUCTURE_MAPPING: capable=True; required coarse-minus-fine mass correction 0.189..0.314 g
G2_BIMODAL_EXTRACTION: capable=True; two populations can change curvature and terminal contrast
